program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)

policy_classification_supported.insufficient_documentation: When unavailable documentation prevents determining the right recipient or right amount, VA classifies the payment as unknown and reports it separately from improper-payment estimates.
policy_classification_supported.documentation_failure_can_still_be_prope: A failure of agency policy, procedure, or documentation does not itself make a payment improper when sufficient evidence establishes the right recipient, right amount, and statutory or regulatory compliance.
policy_classification_supported.monetary_loss: An amount that should not have been paid and in theory could or should be recovered; it is an overpayment.
policy_classification_supported.non_monetary_loss: An underpayment or a technically improper payment to the right recipient in the right amount with a statutory or regulatory failure.
policy_classification_supported.recovery: A monetary-loss improper payment returned to the federal government.
policy_classification_supported.recovery_activity: PIIA samples and post-payment reviews may identify or recapture overpayments, but identification alone is not return of funds.
policy_classification_supported.bill_of_collection: A bill may be a corrective action for an error found in testing; issuance is not certified collection.

recovery_audit_cash_boundary_supported.contractor_fee_basis: actual funds certified recovered, credited, or realized

reported_causes: purchases using a Basic Ordering Agreement rather than a contract

missing documentation related to authorization, payment, or Veteran level of care
pltss_specific_observed.incorrect_amount_process: Post-payment reviews may issue additional payments or establish bills of collection for claims paid in the incorrect amount.
